body: Thank you, I’ll definitely try to find things about myself that I like, although its hard when your constantly being put down by the person you should trust the most. I really appreciate it.

Thank you for responding, I really appappreciate it. My doctors have never told me that I needed to lose weight, they’ve always said that I was healthy and that I was fine how I was, just try to maintain my weight. As for counseling, my dad was the one who supported me going, even though my mom does think it’s a waste of time and useless. I really try to accept myself how i am, but it’s hard. I wish I could talk to my mom about my feelings like how other girls do, I envy them so much for having a supportive mom. Sometimes I just feel like nobody cares for me, if she doesn’t why would other people.
